name: TRACE Expo preview
postCreateCommand: test -f .env || cp .env.example .env; npm install && npm install -g @expo/ngrok
postStartCommand: bash -c 'if ! pgrep -f "[n]ode .devcontainer/preview.cjs" >/dev/null; then nohup node .devcontainer/preview.cjs > /tmp/trace-preview.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & fi'
